title: MechAlign: Evaluating Semantic Alignment at the Project Level in Mathematical Formalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.35269v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lean verifies that a formal proof establishes its stated proposition under declared assumptions, but does not check whether that proposition faithfully expresses the mathematical claim in a manuscript. Assessing this correspondence requires interpreting the main theorem through its project dependencies, which may be scattered throughout a large development. We introduce MechAlign, a framework for project-level semantic alignment review that combines formal dependency extraction with LLM-based assessment. Its extraction tool, LeanTrace, constructs a statement dependency graph from elaborated declarations, retaining definition bodies and structure constraints while excluding proof bodies and stopping at an explicit library boundary. The reviewer uses this context to investigate alignment and report discrepancies with localized evidence. translated_title: MechAlign：在数学形式化中评估项目级别的语义对齐
translated_abstract: Lean 能够验证一个形式化证明在所声明的假设下确立了其所述命题，但并不检查该命题是否忠实地表达了手稿中的数学断言。评估这种对应关系需要通过其项目依赖来解读主要定理，而这些依赖可能分散在一个庞大的开发项目中。我们提出了 MechAlign，这是一个项目级别的语义对齐审查框架，它将形式化依赖提取与基于大语言模型（LLM）的评估相结合。其提取工具 LeanTrace 从详细阐述的声明中构建语句依赖图，保留定义体和结构约束，同时排除证明体，并在明确的库边界处停止。审查者利用这一上下文来调查对齐情况，并报告带有定位证据的差异。我们对来自 173 个 OpenAI Math 项目的 201 个主要结果进行了初步审查，使用所提供的非形式化信息……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: MechAlign 提出了一个项目级语义对齐审查框架，通过依赖提取工具 LeanTrace 构建语句依赖图并结合 LLM 评估，检验 Lean 形式化命题是否忠实表达了手稿中的数学断言，并定位报告其中的差异。
en_tdlr: MechAlign introduces a project-level semantic alignment review framework that combines formal dependency extraction (via its LeanTrace tool) with LLM-based assessment to verify whether Lean formal propositions faithfully express the mathematical claims in manuscripts, reporting discrepancies with localized evidence.
